why_it_matters: Families searching for treatment increasingly ask an AI assistant which centers to call, and they phone the names it gives and the sites it links. fix: Publish answer-ready pages that answer the absent queries in the first two or three sentences (levels of care, insurance, cost, length of stay, location); add Organization/MedicalOrganization entity schema with sameAs links to every directory profile; claim and complete listings on the directories AI cites (freemanrecoverycenter.com, psychologytoday.com, apex.rehab); publish an outcomes page (accreditation, completion and alumni follow-up data) that answers can quote.
check_first: GSC Performance filtered to brand queries (16-month impressions/clicks trend) to see whether AI exposure is already moving branded demand, and add a 'How did you hear about us?' tag in call tracking with an 'AI assistant (ChatGPT/Perplexity)' option so AI-sourced calls are counted before and after the fix.
